title: Three Men in a Basket
question: Where was the station's Commanding Officer?

meanings.usage: 指充气后能飘浮在空中的球状物，常用于娱乐或侦察
指驾驶飞机的人
指驾驶飞机或引导船只
指军事设施、警局或火车站等
机场或军事基地中用于指挥飞机起降的建筑
飞机的总称，复数形式仍为aircraft
指从事情报工作的人
指暗中监视或收集情报
keep track of 意为'追踪/掌握...的动态'
指留下的痕迹或路径
常用于复数形式，指手持的双筒观景设备
指拍摄得到的图片
指用相机拍摄的动作
指从高处向低处移动，是ascend的反义词
指供飞机起飞降落的地方，比airport规模小
指依法扣押嫌疑人
under arrest 意为'被逮捕'
军队中的最高指挥官，常缩写为C.O.
英国议会的下议院议员，简称MP
指令人费解或不知原因的事情

phrases.usage: 驶向/走向某地，表示朝某个方向前进

examples.en: The balloon seemed to be making for the RAF station.
examples.zh: 气球似乎正朝皇家空军基地飘去。

phrases.usage: 追踪/掌握...的动态，保持对某事的了解

examples.en: The pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
examples.zh: 飞行员被命令追踪那个奇怪的物体。

phrases.usage: 辨认出/看清楚/理解，常用于表示看清或辨认某物

examples.en: He could make out three men in a basket.
examples.zh: 他辨认出篮子里有三个人。

phrases.usage: 召来/召集/叫来，指请求某人或某物前来帮助

examples.en: The police were called in.
examples.zh: 警察被召来了。

phrases.usage: 不久之后，表示紧接着发生的动作

examples.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend.
examples.zh: 不久之后，气球开始下降。

phrases.usage: 对...很大的危险，danger后接介词to引出危险对象

examples.en: Balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
examples.zh: 气球可能对飞机造成很大危险。

phrases.usage: 盘旋/环绕飞行，指绕着某物做圆周运动

examples.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
examples.zh: 飞行员设法绕着气球盘旋了一会儿。

phrases.usage: 拍照/摄影，指用相机拍摄照片的动作

examples.en: One of the men was taking photographs.
examples.zh: 其中一个人正在拍照。

phrases.usage: 立即/马上，表示即刻发生的动作

examples.en: He informed the station at once.
examples.zh: 他立刻通知了基地。

phrases.usage: 对...生气，angry后接介词with再加对象

examples.en: The officer was very angry when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 军官听到这个消息后非常生气。

sentences.en: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby.
sentences.zh: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球，它似乎正朝着附近的一个皇家空军基地飞去。

sentences.en: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
sentences.zh: 他立即通知了基地，但那里没有人能解释这个谜团。

sentences.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news,
sentences.zh: 控制塔里的军官听到这个消息后非常生气，

sentences.en: because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
sentences.zh: 因为气球对飞机来说可能是一个巨大的危险。

sentences.en: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
sentences.zh: 他说可能有人在监视基地，飞行员被命令跟踪这个奇怪的物体。

sentences.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
sentences.zh: 飞行员设法绕着气球盘旋了一段时间。

sentences.en: He could make out three men in a basket under it and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
sentences.zh: 他能辨认出气球下面的篮子里有三个人，其中一人拿着一副双筒望远镜。

sentences.en: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
sentences.zh: 当气球飞到基地上空时，飞行员看到其中一个人在拍照。

sentences.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，气球开始下降，并降落在一个机场附近。

sentences.en: The police were called in, but they could not arrest anyone,
sentences.zh: 警方被召来，但他们无法逮捕任何人，

sentences.en: for the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station!
sentences.zh: 因为篮子里坐着两名议会成员和基地的指挥官！

sentences.en: As the Commanding Officer explained later, one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing!
sentences.zh: 正如指挥官后来解释的那样，基地的一半人不知道另一半人在做什么！

exercises.prompt: “下降/降落” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: descend · /dɪˈsend/ · verb · 下降/降落。指从高处向低处移动，是ascend的反义词

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：谜团/神秘事物
exercises.explain: mystery · /ˈmɪstri/ · noun · 谜团/神秘事物。指令人费解或不知原因的事情

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：_____, the balloon began to descend.
exercises.hint: 不久之后，气球开始下降。
exercises.explain: soon afterwards：不久之后，表示紧接着发生的动作（不久之后，气球开始下降。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：A pilot noticed a _____ which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby.
exercises.hint: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球，它似乎正朝着附近的一个皇家空军基地飞去。
exercises.explain: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby. — 一名飞行员注意到一个气球，它似乎正朝着附近的一个皇家空军基地飞去。

source.en: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby.

exercises.prompt: “表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，即'过去的过去'” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主语 + had + 过去分词
options: would + 动词原形（将来过去时）
be going to 表示将来计划或意图
exercises.explain: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)：主语 + had + 过去分词：用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时。常与before、after、by、when等连用。

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
options: 但却一直下雨，而且常常冷得厉害。
我父母过去住在南美洲，我放假时常从欧洲飞到那里。
不久之后，气球开始下降，并降落在一个机场附近。
exercises.explain: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield. — 不久之后，气球开始下降，并降落在一个机场附近。

source.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作
grammar.usage: 用于描述正在进行的动作，或与一般过去时连用表示一个动作发生时另一个动作正在进行。通常与when、while、as等连用。

examples.en: The balloon seemed to be making for the RAF station.
examples.zh: 气球似乎正朝皇家空军基地飘去。

examples.en: One of the men was taking photographs.
examples.zh: 其中一个人正在拍照。

examples.en: While the pilot was circling the balloon, he saw three men.
examples.zh: 当飞行员绕着气球盘旋时，他看到了三个人。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，即'过去的过去'
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时。常与before、after、by、when等连用。

examples.en: He had never seen anything like it before.
examples.zh: 他以前从未见过这样的东西。

examples.en: When the police arrived, the balloon had already landed.
examples.zh: 警察到达时，气球已经降落了。

grammar.title: when引导的时间状语从句
grammar.definition: when引导的从句表示主句动作发生的时间
grammar.structure: 主句 + when + 从句 / when + 从句 + 主句
grammar.usage: when引导的从句中，如果动作正在进行（长动作），用过去进行时；如果动作发生（短动作），用一般过去时。主句用一般过去时。

examples.en: The officer was very angry when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 军官听到消息时非常生气。

examples.en: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
examples.zh: 当气球飞临基地上空时，飞行员看到其中一人正在拍照。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing + when + 主语 + 动词-ed

original.en: The officer was very angry when he heard the news.
original.zh: 军官听到消息时非常生气。

examples.en: The pilot was watching the balloon when it began to descend.
examples.zh: 飞行员正在观察气球时，它开始下降了。

examples.en: I was having dinner when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我正在吃晚饭时电话响了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + could make out + 宾语

original.en: He could make out three men in a basket under it.
original.zh: 他能辨认出气球下面篮子里有三个人。

examples.en: From the plane, he could make out the coastline.
examples.zh: 从飞机上他能辨认出海岸线。

examples.en: I could make out a figure in the distance.
examples.zh: 我能辨认出远处有一个人影。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be ordered to + 动词原形

original.en: The pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
original.zh: 飞行员被命令追踪那个奇怪的物体。

examples.en: The soldiers were ordered to march forward.
examples.zh: 士兵们被命令向前行进。

examples.en: He was ordered to report to the commander immediately.
examples.zh: 他被命令立即向指挥官报到。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be + 形容词 + when + 从句

original.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news.
original.zh: 指挥塔里的军官听到消息时非常生气。

examples.en: She was surprised when she saw the result.
examples.zh: 她看到结果时很惊讶。

examples.en: The teacher was delighted when the students answered correctly.
examples.zh: 学生正确回答时老师很高兴。
